reference_device_note: Measured on the Poco X5 Pro 5G (SM7325 / Android 14 / Adreno 642L). AC15: these are REAL reference-device numbers but they bind NEITHER PERF-002 NOR PERF-010 — both re-baseline with Story 12.3, and PERF-010 is a SOFT target, not a measured floor. The engine brief's <10 s is the aspiration, not an acceptance criterion. Parity figures are an IN-SAMPLE parity target, never accuracy-in-the-world; REL-006's >=95% floor is 9.9b's, instrumented by Tool 9 via 9.16.

thermal.note: 0 = NONE. Anything above LIGHT means the governor is capping clocks and every ms/keyframe figure in this report is a throttled measurement, not a capability measurement.

engine.kind: CPU integer rule evaluation on MediaCodec keyframe decode
engine.color_conversion: WardenColorConvert — bt709 limited range, nearest chroma
engine.note: architecture.md Decision #13. No EGL context, no GL thread affinity, no LUT texture upload, no readback synchronisation, and no driver-defined colour conversion.

mediacodec.sync_sample_count_source: NOT MEASURED — this profile never runs the 62 s ground-truth walk (Story 12.4a AC3). A bench mode that needs it scans explicitly and passes it in; -1 means no mode in this run asked.

ac2_color_constants.note: Exhaustive over the WHOLE (Y, Cb, Cr) domain — 16,777,216 triples, bit-for-bit against ac3_numpy_reference.shader_model. A match means the ported ARITHMETIC is right, not merely that the constants are: the literal checks in colorConvert.test.ts and verify-constants cannot distinguish a transcribed operator error. WardenColorConvert computes in fp64 where the shader ran at ESSL highp (fp32); measured on PC the two disagree on 109 of 16,777,216 triples (0.00065%), max 1 unit — 275x rarer than the published-rounding error the BT.709 four-decimal constants already carry, and inside the same envelope.

ac3_frame_diff.note: The SHIPPED converter's output for one real keyframe. Expected residual against FFmpeg rgb24 is a nearest-vs-swscale chroma upsampling difference (ΔS ≈ 2.46, ≤ 3 units), NOT a matrix error. `whole_frame_convert_ms` is the cost the bound path does NOT pay: it converts rule regions only.
